_comment: Copy to acl.json (gitignored, chmod 600) and edit. Values below are examples.
projects: alias -> Todoist project id. This map is the outer boundary of the
service. A project absent from it cannot be reached by anyone, whatever their
scope, which is what makes granting "*" safe: it means every project listed
here, not every project in the account. Leave out anything an agent should
principals: one entry per consumer, keyed by API key. Never share a key
between two consumers — the key is the identity, and the audit log records
role: "write" or "read". A read principal is not shown the mutating tools
projects: a list of aliases, or "*" for all of them.
